scope: Propuesta académica retrospectiva de costos y capacidad sobre predicciones ya obtenidas. No se entrena ni se promueve un modelo oficial.
currency: Unidades monetarias en la misma escala numérica que amount; sin conversión a CLP ni costos empresariales acreditados.
loss_reference: mean(max(amount,0)) among every fraud in the common training period before validation; includes negative-amount frauds with zero direct positive exposure, never removes their labels
cost_scope: Incremental decision cost. The avoidable share is a scenario, not a measured recovery rate. Remaining unavoidable fraud loss is common across actions and omitted. No automatic blocking, customer-friction estimate, fixed infrastructure cost or future-card-loss estimate is assumed.
secondary_cost: review_cost * (TP+FP) + avoidable_fraction * sum(max(amount,0) for FN); use base hourly cost and capacity, all three avoidable fractions
cost_selection: Minimum validation cost subject to aggregate validation capacity; ties use fewer alerts, then candidate name, then highest threshold. Include no-alert policy.
recall_frontier: Maximum validation TP subject to capacity, optionally requiring cost no larger than no-alert cost; ties use fewer FP, candidate name, higher threshold.
comparison: Same evaluation IDs and labels across all candidates; compare base cost threshold with F1 threshold of same selected model, plus pool F1 winner and no-alert/0.5 references.
holdout_rule: Serialize every threshold, candidate and cost parameter before reading evaluation predictions in this analysis. Past rounds have already explored evaluation years; this does not make them new independent holdouts.
operational_check: Report aggregate and monthly observed alert loads. A validation capacity constraint is not a hard production queue limit; no alerts are silently removed on evaluation.
recommended_use: Academic decision proposal for review, not approval for automatic financial blocking or replacement of the official S9 artifact.
